heaviest_rainfall.status: 29.53mm of rain was recorded as having fallen today, marking an exceptional precipitation event and it ranked 6th out of our records.  A rate of 9.4mm per hour was recorded during the 36.8 hour long storm.  The most intense rainfall recorded took place on 09 November 2025, with precipitation totalling 47.89mm.  The rain fell at 24.6mm per hour at times over the course of the 144.8 hour storm.

heaviest_rainrate.status: On 02 September 2025, the rain fell at an exceptional rate, peaking at 34.3mm per hour, the heaviest downpour recorded.  A total of 21.19mm fell over the 15.0 hour storm.

longest_rain.status: The storm today ranked 4th for the length of the storm when compared to others in our records and it lasted 36.8 hours.  29.53mm of rain fell and at one point was falling at 9.4mm per hour.  Rain fell for 144.8 hours on 09 November 2025 creating a new record that still lasts.  The storm produced a total of 47.89mm with a maximum intensity of 24.6mm per hour.
